title: SSR Chronological Realignment Array: finite-lattice reference implementation
description:
Finite-lattice reference implementation (Python and JavaScript) of the formal core of Stratified Source Realism (SSR) and the SSR Chronological Realignment Array Model v4.0: complete lattice P(U), a provably monotone demonstration operator, least-fixed-point iteration (Knaster–Tarski), an ε-tolerant metric filter with an independent equivalence relation, and a cross-stratum coherence check. VALID_RESULT is gated on FixedPoint ∧ InvariantPass ∧ CoherencePass.

Honest boundary: a formal/computational model only. It makes no empirical or physical claims and implements no physical chronological displacement.
